test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 11 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Two statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All dogs are cats.

No cat is a rat.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some rats are cats.

II. Some dogs are rats.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow.

solution:
We draw a Venn diagram using the given statements:

All dogs are cats.

No cat is a rat.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47374885d5554e9c4e926929842c04df74d9a8106d82184b18e9edf59129e870.png] 

Now we consider the given conclusions:

I. Some rats are cats → Does not follow&nb
